en.headline: Linn says Northern Metropolis bill would speed land production
en.dek: The development secretary said passing the ordinance would give officials more room to create ready land faster, with a 900-hectare target by 2030.
body: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said on Friday that land production in the Northern Metropolis could be faster and larger in scale if the Legislative Council passes the Northern Metropolis Development Bill.

Speaking on a radio programme, Linn said the first five-year plan sets a binding target of 900 hectares of ready land in the Northern Metropolis by 2030. She said progress so far had been satisfactory and that the government would not have set a binding indicator if it lacked confidence. Funding has already been secured for works in Hung Shui Kiu, Kwu Tung and San Tin, she said, while other sites are preparing funding applications.

Linn said the bill was intended to cut procedural barriers. If it is passed, she said, officials would have more confidence that land can be produced more quickly and in greater quantity. She told Now News on Thursday that the government hoped the bill would clear the legislature this year, with subsidiary legislation to follow so that streamlining measures could take effect in the first quarter of next year.

On industrial sites, Linn said the government should first sound out potential tenants on planning conditions, adjust the terms, and only then put land out to open tender. She said past reluctance to talk to firms for fear of being accused of collusion was the wrong mindset, provided tender conditions remain public. Pushing a sale when a failed tender looks likely, she said, would waste effort.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：北都條例草案通過後造地可更快更多
zh.dek: 發展局局長在電台表示，條例有助拆牆鬆綁，五年規劃訂下2030年北都產出900公頃熟地的約束性指標。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周五表示，若立法會通過《北部都會區發展條例草案》，日後在北都造地可以更快、更多。
她在電台節目說，首份五年規劃提出到2030年北部都會區熟地產出量達900公頃，屬約束性指標。她指目前進展良好，否則不敢訂立該指標。未來幾年會加快造地，已獲撥款在洪水橋、古洞及新田等地開展工程，部分地點則正準備申請撥款。
甯漢豪形容條例有助拆牆鬆綁，通過後當局造地會「更有底氣」。她周四接受Now新聞訪問時說，希望草案年內獲通過，其後提交附屬法例，令精簡措施可於明年第1季生效。
產業用地方面，她說推出前應先了解有意參與企業的需要，就規劃初步方案徵集意見、調整條件，再公開招標。她指過去因忌諳「勾結」字眼而不與潛在企業商討，屬不應有的思維，最重要是招標條件公開、讓各方競投。若明知流標風險高仍硬推，只是浪費氣力。
